question: Identify the odd option from among the following.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Argon**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Argon (Ar) is the odd one out **of the elements bromine (Br), chlorine (Cl), and fluorine (F) **because it is an inert gas, also known as a noble gas.**
 
• **Argon is an inert gas** with a **full outermost shell, which means it has no capacity to fill more electrons.**
 
• It has the **lowest electron affinit**y because it doesn't want to lose or gain any electrons.
 
• The **Atomic number of Argon is 18**
 
• Argon was discovered in 1894 by British scientists Lord Rayleigh and Sir William Ramsay
 
• The name argon comes from the Greek word Argos, which means "inactive" ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Fluorine

 
• Atomic number: 9.
 
• Symbol: F.
 
• Most electronegative element.
 
• First isolated by Henri Moissan.

Bromine

 
• Atomic number: 35.
 
• Symbol: Br.
 
• It is the third-lightest halogen and is a fuming red-brown liquid at room temperature that evaporates readily to form a similarly coloured gas.
 
• Its properties are thus intermediate between those of chlorine and iodine.

Chlorine

 
• Atomic number 17.
 
• Symbol Cl.
 
• Discovered by Carl Wilhelm Scheele.
 
• Second-lightest of the halogens.
